acceptanceCriteria: Read-only: no fetch and no writes (invariant 4).
Only commits that change configured shared paths count; feature commits on base are ignored.
The dry-merge result is one of clean, generated-only or conflict, and a conflict lists the conflicting paths.
JSON output records base, head, the commits and the config digest.
The doctor finding names the ticket, the oldest missing shared commit and its age.
The requirements are recorded in the shared-path policy spec (or a domain spec), traced to tests.
body: GitHub #1092. Long-lived ticket branches miss shared-path fixes (helpers, fixtures, config) that landed on the integration branch; workers debug already-fixed failures and record wrong blocked causes (observed: 8 of 15 branches lacked a login-helper fix after 4 days). Proposal: read-only `corvint changes behind --base REF [--head REV] [--config FILE]` over the corvint-shared-paths/0 policy (docs/specs/shared-path-change-policy-v0.md, V1-1591/V1-1620) listing base commits not on head that change a shared path, with commit+subject, shared paths changed, head overlap (conflict risk), and dry merge-tree result clean|generated-only|conflict. Also a dispatch/doctor finding for a live ticket worktree lacking shared commits older than N hours, and an optional claim-result notice.
title: changes behind: report shared-path commits a ticket branch is missing from its base (GitHub #1092)
